name: devflow
description: An Issue-driven development loop for Claude Code and Codex: resume from Issues, delegate reads and checks, back rules with hooks.

interface.longDescription: devflow resumes Issue-tracked work from the Issue's state and checkpoints. A router skill picks the lifecycle stage (discover, design, plan, build, verify, review, ship, learn), delegates reads and checks to fresh-context agents, and lifecycle hooks inject the resume card, continue autonomous work within task limits, and release sessions when they end. Companion skills cover starting work, PR review and integration, workspace cleanup, decision interviews, prompt generation and writing for agents.
